goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo (index.html, engine3d.js, scene.js, app.js) with a software 3D renderer on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">, dark radial-gradient space background, two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel and crown cap (36 box faces), six orbiting octahedral crystals (48 triangles), portal core with two counter-rotating neon rings (#00f5ff and #ff2ae6), cyber grid floor, 180 twinkling stars, 110 rising particles, orbiting camera, and a glassmorphism HUD (NEON PORTAL 3D, #fps, #polys, #parts, #btn-pause, #btn-orbit, #btn-reset, #speed slider).
constraints: Full-viewport <canvas id='c'> fills the screen with zero scrollbars.
Canvas draws a dark radial-gradient space background (#060318 center to #010108 edge).
Software 3D renderer in engine3d.js implements perspective projection and 3D rotation.
Software 3D renderer in engine3d.js implements backface culling, painter's z-sort, and flat lighting.
Scene in scene.js builds a two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel, and crown cap totaling 36 box faces.
Scene in scene.js builds six orbiting octahedral crystals totaling 48 triangles.
Portal core renders a glowing center with two counter-rotating neon rings (#00f5ff and #ff2ae6).
Scene includes a perspective cyber grid floor.
Camera auto-orbits when Orbit ON is active and supports pointer drag.
Glassmorphism HUD displays the title 'NEON PORTAL 3D'.
HUD button #btn-pause toggles animation and switches text between 'Pause' and 'Resume'.
HUD button #btn-orbit toggles camera auto-orbit and switches text between 'Orbit ON' and 'Orbit OFF'.
HUD button #btn-reset restores default camera, speed=1, Orbit ON, and running state.
HUD slider #speed (min 0.1, max 3, step 0.1, value 1) scales animation speed.
index.html loads engine3d.js, scene.js, and app.js via standard local <script> tags with no external CDN.
